text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British sources deny U.S. claims of a power struggle in Baghdad.
- Yemen denounces foreign interference in Sudan's affairs.
- Kenyan president receives Iraq's minister of higher education.
- Saudi Arabia on a multi-billion arms deal with Washington.
- Washington promises to supply Israel with warplanes more advanced than those to be given to the Saudis.
- Central Bank calls for the formation of more government- licensed exchange houses.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Jordanian party urges Arabs to support Iraq.
- Editorial assails U.S. claims of a power struggle in Baghdad.
- Algeria warns France against meddling in its internal affairs.
- Saudi Arabian blast investigations spark differences between Washington and Riyadh.
- Palestinian President Arafat to visit the Netherlands on Monday.
- Iraqi engineers reconstruct 30 industrial projects in Babylon.
- Editorial blasts U.S. claims of instability in Iraq.
